text:
alex_support: hi @customer_jd — got your ticket about promo codes, can you confirm the two codes you applied?
customer_jd: sure — applied NEWUSER50 through the dashboard on Mon, then used the API to apply SPRING2026 yesterday. dashboard still shows both, billing only charged against SPRING2026.
alex_support: thanks. can you paste the API request id or a snippet? any error returned?
customer_jd: request id r_2026_0001, no error, response 200 with "applied": true. payload was: ```{
  "code": "SPRING2026"
}```
alex_support: ok. tagging @mari_billing and @devon_eng to check stacking rules and if API default was replace.
mari_billing: looking — portal UI shows stacking allowed for NEWUSER50 + seasonal promos, but our admin API has an optional param `mode` (stack|replace). if omitted, older API versions default to replace. do you know which SDK/version you used?
customer_jd: used the python SDK v0.2.1 installed via pip last month. i didn't set any mode.
devon_eng: that SDK in v0.2.1 maps to backend endpoint /v1/promos/apply without mode, server falls back to legacy behavior (replace). we pushed a change in v0.3.0 to default to stack when product allows it.
alex_support: so dashboard flow was stack, API call replaced. i can issue a manual credit re-add while we sort. @mari_billing can you confirm reversible credit amount?
mari_billing: yes — NEWUSER50 was a $50 credit. i'll queue a manual apply for acct_9043 and add a note referencing r_2026_0001. should be visible in next 10-15m.
promo-bot: (system) Manual credit +50 USD applied to acct_9043 by mari_billing. note: source=manual-adjust, ref=r_2026_0001.
customer_jd: thanks! any timeline for fixing the SDK behavior?
devon_eng: we'll ship a patch to v0.3.1 today that either requires explicit `mode` or honors dashboard stacking rules. i'll open a PR and link it here.
alex_support: for now i'll close the ticket after you confirm refund/credit posted. please reopen if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
customer_jd: confirmed the +$50 appeared. appreciate the quick help.
devon_eng: tracking item: ENG-2845 update promo apply default to align with portal. leaving note to backfill audits for any replaced-applies in last 30 days.
alex_support: copying into the customer notes and marking resolved. thanks everyone.
